messages:
jamal: heads-up — deploy-bot has paused the promotion for release v2.4.1, reason: registry index lookup 404 for artifact app-server@sha256:deadbeef and smoke tests 2/4 hit infra timeouts. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/99876 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=artifact_index_not_found, artifact=app-server@sha256:deadbeef, auto_retries=2
jamal: logs snapshot:
```
WARN registry: lookup missing key: artifacts/app-server/sha256:deadbeef
ERROR smoke-test[db-init]: timed out waiting for ephemeral-db to accept connections (30s)
```
katie: fwiw the registry returned 202 on upload earlier; we suspect index write latency on the region mirror. mirror-sync lag has caused similar 404s in the past.
maria: It retried twice already and then paused. If mirror catches up in ~60s it usually resolves. But change window ends in 18m.
devops-lead: Options: 1) short hold (5m) and auto-rerun, 2) manual-promote last-known-good artifact to unstick window, 3) full CI rerun (long). Risk assessment?
jamal: last-known-good for app-server is sha256:cafef00d promoted to stable 2h ago. No regressions reported for that commit.
qa-bot: Regression checklist: unit + integration green on last-good; e2e limited (smoke) previously flaky but historical pass rate 95%.
devops-lead: My call — manual-promote previous artifact to stable, annotate release notes, and open a follow-up to re-run CI for the new build after the window. We should avoid missing the change window. Need one approver. @maria can you ack?
maria: ack +1 to manual promote. keep note in release notes: "Promoted previous artifact due to transient registry index propagation; follow-up CI scheduled."
jamal: add a follow-up ticket: TKT-5421 "Investigate registry index commit vs mirror sync latency causing 404 during promote". assign infra.
devops-lead: Running promote command now: `deployctl promote --artifact app-server@sha256:cafef00d --target=stable --reason "index propagation; smoke flake" --annotate "manual pin due to index lag"`
deploy-bot: Promotion executed by devops-lead. stable -> app-server@sha256:cafef00d. Note recorded in release metadata.
qa-bot: Release notes snippet suggested: "Temporary pin to previous app-server artifact to avoid missing change window; automated follow-up to rerun failing build post-window."
jamal: thanks — window unblocked. scheduling the CI rerun for the original build at +30m.
maria: leaving TODO: if rerun passes, decide whether to re-promote or leave pinned. If fails, create rollback/patch plan.
devops-lead: I'll update the release draft and TKT-5421. closing thread — ping me if the rerun outcome suggests another action. :rocket:
